problem: The negative-amount and finiteness checks were removed, so allocate(-10,[1,1]) returns negative shares and NaN/Infinity leak ValueError/OverflowError.
int() truncates the scaled amount, so amounts with more than `places` decimals (e.g. "0.005") silently lose money where main raised ValueError.

The empty-weights and positive-weight checks were removed, so negative or mixed-sign weights and an empty list are accepted and shares no longer sum to the amount (allocate(10,[1,-1]) gives [10.01,-9.99]).
`sum(ws) or Fraction(1)` masks a zero total weight, so allocate(10,[0,0]) returns [0.01,0.01] and invents money instead of raising.
Decimal(str(x)) replaces _to_decimal, so floats and bools that main rejected with TypeError are accepted, and _to_decimal is now dead code.
The places validation was removed, so places=-1 returns [1E+1, 0E+1] and non-int places fails with a leaked Decimal TypeError.
max(leftover, 0) silences a negative leftover, so a broken conservation invariant returns wrong shares instead of failing.
The comment documenting the largest-remainder tie-break by lowest index (stable sort) was deleted.
